preguntas.enunciado: What does the cosine similarity between two embedding vectors measure?
opciones: How aligned their directions are, i.e. semantic similarity
The number of dimensions they share
preguntas.explicacion: Cosine similarity compares the angle between vectors, so it captures semantic closeness independent of magnitude.

preguntas.enunciado: Why are embeddings often normalized to unit length before a nearest-neighbour search?
opciones: So the dot product equals the cosine similarity
preguntas.explicacion: With unit-length vectors the dot product is exactly the cosine similarity, which is what most vector indexes optimise for.
